evals.prompt: Schrijf een mail naar een klant in Belgisch Nederlands. De oplevering schuift twee weken op, en we willen een nieuwe afspraak voorstellen voor 21 oktober 2025.
evals.expected_output: A Belgian Dutch email that consistently addresses the reader with `u`, closes with `Met vriendelijke groeten`, carries at least one modal particle, and contains none of the flagged calques or mechanical errors.
assertions: The email addresses the reader with `u` throughout and never switches to `je` or `jij`
The closing is `Met vriendelijke groeten`, not the Netherlands form `Met vriendelijke groet`
The text contains no em-dash character (U+2014)
The text contains at least one modal particle from: wel, toch, eens, even, maar, nu, al, gewoon, hoor, zeker
The text contains none of: `teneinde`, `middels`, `dient te`, or `welke` used as a relative pronoun
No sentence begins with `Echter,`
The date is written as `21 oktober 2025`, not `oktober 21, 2025`, and the month is lowercase

evals.prompt: Schrijf een LinkedIn-post voor de Nederlandse markt over onze nieuwe exportfunctie. Informeel, met een kop erboven.
evals.expected_output: A Netherlands Dutch LinkedIn post using `je`, a sentence-case heading without a full stop, varied sentence rhythm, and no AI calques.
assertions: The post addresses the reader with `je` or `jij`, not `u`
The heading is in sentence case, has no full stop, and is not Title Case
The text contains no em-dash character (U+2014)
The text contains none of: `Voel je vrij om`, `Wij zijn verheugd`, `naadloos`, `uitdagingen` used to mean problems
Sentence length varies: the shortest sentence is under 10 words and the longest is over 18 words
At least two sentences open with something other than the grammatical subject
No three consecutive sentences open with the same word

evals.prompt: Kan je dit even in het Nederlands zetten? "We're excited to announce our new pricing, and we believe it will seamlessly address the challenges our customers face."
evals.expected_output: The skill asks whether the target is Belgian or Netherlands Dutch before committing to a final text, rather than silently defaulting, and does not render the English sentence word for word.
assertions: The response asks which variant to use (BE or NL) before delivering the final text, rather than silently producing one variant
The output does not contain `Wij zijn verheugd aan te kondigen` or any near-literal rendering of `We're excited to announce`
The output does not contain `naadloos`, `adresseren` meaning to address a problem, or `uitdagingen` meaning problems
The output does not contain `Wij geloven dat`

evals.prompt: Kan je deze tekst nakijken? Hij leest als een vertaling uit het Engels. Doelgroep is Nederland.
evals.expected_output: A repaired version of the file in which each of the seven structural tells present in the source has been fixed, plus a short account of what was changed and why.
assertions: `Drie opties zijn beschikbaar` is rewritten to a presentational `er` construction such as `Er zijn drie opties`
`Niets is veranderd` is rewritten to `Er is niets veranderd`
The heading `Onze Nieuwe Samenwerking` is rewritten to sentence case
The em-dash character (U+2014) is gone from the rewritten text
The sentence-initial `Echter,` is gone, replaced by `echter` in mid-sentence position or by `Maar`
`wij zullen volgende week starten` is rewritten to a present tense such as `we starten volgende week`
The nominalisation `Het uitvoeren van de migratie gebeurt door ons team` is rewritten to an active verb such as `ons team voert de migratie uit`
The rewritten text contains none of: `teneinde`, `welke` as a relative pronoun, `Voel je vrij om`, `naadloos`, `Wij zijn verheugd aan te kondigen`, `Wij geloven dat`
`op kantoor gisteren` is reordered to `gisteren op kantoor`, following Time-Manner-Place
The response names which of the seven tells it fixed
